mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering short-term equity sell-offs as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 20-day windows when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.3pp increase from prior month) signals price pressures prompting delayed Fed rate cuts, causing short-term equity volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS above 12-month moving average) indicates robust labor market expansion, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 500000) during expansionary regimes boosts corporate revenues, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 55% of 60-day windows when RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based supply shocks, reducing corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:BEA Industrial Production and Housing Reports
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
